source.label: Kineticist Stern Jurassic Park tournament strategy

supportingSources.label: Tilt Forums Stern Jurassic Park rulesheet
PAPA Jurassic Park tutorial with Bowen Kerins
Escher Lefkoff at Stern Pro Circuit Championship 2023 — Round 3

strategy.summary: Prepare Raptor Tri-Ball, capture the first dinosaur on an outside route, then choose System Boot when its exact combos are controlled and use Raptor to protect the route.

steps.text: Try the skill-shot chain: left ramp, right ramp, tower ramp, then O. Use each return to measure the copy.
Complete the Raptor Pen bank twice. Shoot the center dead-end lane and reduce fence integrity to zero, but stop before the final dead-end start.
modeNotes: Raptor preparation: Bank completions qualify the center capture. The first dead-end shot captures a ball; fence hits then lower integrity to zero. The next dead-end shot starts Raptor Tri-Ball.

steps.text: Shoot one white MAP arrow. Shoot the left ramp to start the first Paddock, then capture its dinosaur.
modeNotes: Paddock: Shoot one red Rescue and one yellow Set Trap target. The first Paddock does not require the Helipad.
Shoot the moving yellow-green dinosaur arrow to capture the dinosaur and end the Paddock.
A capture gives a permanent Paddock Perk. The first capture lights Control Room.

steps.text: Keep the truck on an outside route. This reaches Visitor Center through fewer difficult Paddocks.
Shoot C. Select System Boot at Control Room when its exact two-shot combos are controlled.
modeNotes: System Boot: Complete one two-shot combo from each opener: left ramp, Helipad, and spinner. Return to C for the combined collect and Fossil.
Current tournament guidance ranks System Boot above Restore Power when the exact combos are reliable.

steps.text: Complete all three purple targets so Supply Drop is ready. Leave the far-right 2x target available.
modeNotes: Supply Drop: The large target gives an award after the three purple targets are complete.
Each collected Supply Drop lights the far-right target for 45 seconds of 2x playfield scoring.
The first Supply Drop collected during Raptor Tri-Ball adds a ball.

steps.text: Shoot the final center dead-end lane to start Raptor Tri-Ball. Collect the first Supply Drop for add-a-ball, then start 2x only when the far-right target angle is safe.
modeNotes: Raptor Tri-Ball phase 1: Shoot both ramps. The second ramp jackpot is double.
Phase 2: Shoot all five C-H-A-O-S jackpots.
Phase 3: The game adds three balls. Shoot the right ramp for 2x and the upper loop for 3x, multiplied by balls in play.
Phase 4: Shoot C-H-A-O-S victory laps. The dead-end lane relights them. The feature ends when one ball remains.

steps.text: Finish System Boot's three exact combos and return to C. Score both Raptor ramp jackpots, complete C-H-A-O-S, and prioritize the upper loop during the six-ball phase.

quickInfo.name: Raptor Tri-Ball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the Raptor Pen bank twice, capture a ball, lower fence integrity, then return to the dead-end lane for the start.

quickInfo.name: System Boot
quickInfo.summary: Start it at Control Room, complete one two-shot combo from each of its three openers, then return to C for the Fossil.

quickInfo.name: Supply Drop 2x
quickInfo.summary: Complete the three purple targets, collect Supply Drop, then hit the far-right target for 45 seconds of 2x playfield scoring.

quickInfo.name: Feed T-Rex Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Spell T-REX, build and collect the hurry-up at the left ramp, then clear C-H-A-O-S before the left-ramp Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Paddocks
quickInfo.summary: Follow the MAP, rescue staff, set the trap, and capture each dinosaur to earn persistent route perks.

quickInfo.name: Modes and Multiball
quickInfo.summary: A Control Room mode can run with one Multiball and non-T-Rex modes. A single-ball T-Rex Event can run with one Multiball and non-Control Room modes. Control Room modes and T-Rex Events do not run together.

fallback.title: Feed T-Rex Multiball
fallback.when: Use this plan when C, the Raptor Pen, or the far-right 2x target rejects.

steps.text: Hit the truck three times on default settings to spell T-REX and start the hurry-up.
Shoot orange arrows. Each shot resets the timer to 20 seconds and raises the value.
Shoot the left ramp when the value is adequate. Do not overbuild without ball save.
During two-ball T-Rex Multiball, shoot all five C-H-A-O-S jackpots. Then shoot the left ramp for the Super Jackpot.
modeNotes: The collected hurry-up becomes the jackpot base.
A left-to-right jackpot sequence adds 1x to the next jackpot and 250,000 to its value.
The Super equals the jackpot sum. A Super relights jackpots and resets the multiplier.

alternatives.title: Restore Power and Raptor stack
alternatives.when: Use this lower-precision route when System Boot's exact two-shot combos are unreliable.

steps.text: Start Restore Power at Control Room after the first dinosaur capture.
Shoot the spinner, then start Raptor Tri-Ball. Restore Power continues during the Multiball.
modeNotes: A Control Room mode can run with one Multiball. A second Multiball cannot start during the overlap.

steps.text: Use the extra balls to complete Restore Power's seven broadly lit major shots.
Make the final lit shot for the Fossil, then resume the Raptor jackpot sequence.

alternatives.title: 2x Chaos comeback
alternatives.when: Use this high-ceiling line when 2x, Chaos Multiball, an active Paddock, and a T-Rex Event are already aligned.

steps.text: Start 2x before the protected scoring window.
Start Chaos Multiball while the Paddock and single-ball T-Rex Event are active. The T-Rex Event continues during the Multiball.
modeNotes: A single-ball T-Rex Event can run with one Multiball. Multiball T-Rex Events cannot stack with another Multiball.

steps.text: Use a Smart Missile for Clear Paddock when that removes the least controllable requirement.
Prioritize overlapping lit shots while the 2x timer and extra balls remain active.

alternatives.title: Amber Bonus
alternatives.when: Use this line on a pop-heavy copy when the precision shots are not reliable.

steps.text: Use bumpers to build the Amber base for the game.
Use the top rollover to light the amber-mine target.
Capture dinosaurs to add multipliers to the next Amber collect.
Shoot the amber target to collect the base with stored multipliers.
The base does not reset. End-of-ball bonus spends the current multiplier.
Complete the outside-route Paddocks to reach Visitor Center.
Play all three Control Room modes to qualify Secure Control Room, and all four T-Rex Events to qualify Museum Mayhem.
Complete modes and Raptor Super Jackpots to earn Fossils. Follow the installed display for the next lit mini-wizard start because the start shot can change with the goal.

checkBeforePlay: Competition Install, first T-Rex Event, Paddock order, Raptor locks, ball saves, Extra Ball conversion, and Supply Drop thresholds can change with operator settings.
Test Raptor Pen, dead-end lane, truck, C, spinner, Helipad, Supply Drop, far-right 2x target, ramps, and upper-loop returns.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand the Raptor Pen and Set Trap targets from their same-side flippers when the local copy accepts those angles.

techniques.name: C shot from the right
techniques.instruction: Shoot C from a right-flipper cradle. Use the shot for Control Room and mode collects.

techniques.name: O aiming mark
techniques.instruction: Aim at the light-brown area above the Jurassic Park logo for the O shot.

techniques.name: Dead bounce
techniques.instruction: Use a late left-flipper shot into Helipad, then dead bounce a weak rejection to the opposite flipper.

techniques.name: Cradle separation
techniques.instruction: Hold one ball. Use the other ball for a clean jackpot shot during Raptor Tri-Ball.

techniques.name: Ski pass
techniques.instruction: Ski-pass the left-ramp return. Shoot C for the first C-H-A-O-S jackpot.

cautions.issue: A weak spinner shot can drain down the middle.
cautions.response: Shoot the spinner firmly, or use another feed to the top.

cautions.issue: The far-right 2x target has a dangerous angle.
cautions.response: Use a late left-flipper shot. Do not force 2x when the angle is not dialed in.

cautions.issue: Feed T-Rex has no multiball ball save until the left-ramp collect.
cautions.response: Collect a moderate hurry-up instead of overbuilding it on an unknown copy.

cautions.issue: The Pro Raptor Pen can reject direct forehands.
cautions.response: Use the left-flipper backhand when it is available and its return is safe.

strategy.overview: Jurassic Park uses first Paddock capture to light Control Room before Raptor Tri-Ball. Complete the Raptor Pen twice, capture at the dead-end lane, lower fence to zero, then leave final start ready. Shoot one white MAP arrow and the left ramp, capture an outside-route dinosaur, then shoot C for System Boot; start Raptor, collect Supply Drop for add-a-ball, then hit far-right target for 2x.
strategy.simpleOverview: Jurassic Park rewards the first Paddock capture with Control Room access; Raptor Tri-Ball can use Supply Drop for add-a-ball and the far-right target for 2x. Shoot one white MAP arrow and the left ramp for the first Paddock; rescue staff, set the trap, then capture the dinosaur. Complete the Raptor Pen twice, capture at the dead-end lane, lower fence integrity to zero, then return there for Tri-Ball; complete purple targets, collect Supply Drop, then hit the far-right target for 2x.
